_doc: toolkit.serve MCP profile wire (SPEC §7C). Every port starts toolkit.serve with an `mcp` profile (no a2a needed), sends each case's request to <url><path> over real HTTP, and asserts the exact status and the listed response headers (names case-insensitive). Change a byte here => change it in all eight ports in the same PR.

cases.name: get_mcp_is_405_allow_post
cases.why: The serve profile is stateless: there is no server-initiated SSE stream. A GET must be refused at once, not held open (a client that opens one waits forever).
